last_quiz.subject: ENGLISH
last_quiz.question: Select the sentence in which the idiom is used correctly.

options.A: She decided to bite the bullet and accept the promotion.
options.B: He let the cat out of the bag when he mentioned the surprise party.
options.C: They were on cloud nine after hearing the news.
options.D: She spilled the beans by revealing the secret plan.

last_quiz.explanation: 'On cloud nine' means extremely happy; the sentence uses it appropriately. The other idioms are mismatched with context.
